capabilities: Read the Zotero database directly without exporting JSON or installing Zotero plugins
Create or update a literature note for a selected reference
Update all notes for references changed in Zotero since the last run
Customize note templates with Zotero metadata placeholders
Control how existing notes are overwritten or preserved
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Unlike the original bibnotes, it does not import PDF highlights, annotations, or images; users wanting those features are pointed to the original plugin.
intentEvidence: This is a personalized fork based on stefanopagliari/bibnotes.
motivation: The author wanted to simplify the original plugin, reduce configuration complexity, and encourage users to manually organize notes rather than auto-import all annotations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull bibliographic metadata from a Zotero library, and existing importers require exporting files or configuring Zotero plugins.

summary: Simplified fork of bibnotes that imports reference metadata from the Zotero database into literature notes, excluding highlights and annotations.
